svg.title: Map of Ahmedabad, with the Sabarmati marked in orange
svg.desc: A street map of Ahmedabad drawn from OpenStreetMap data. The Sabarmati river runs north to south through the centre in orange, dividing the newer west of the city from the walled old city on the east bank, which is ringed and labelled.

g.text: G U J A R A T · I N D I A
